The 4Cs of a diamond price one stone four separate ways, and only one of the four is a decision anyone makes.

Carat, color and clarity are fixed the day the rough is found. Cut is the cutter's choice — GIA grades it only for the standard round brilliant, from Excellent to Poor, on brightness, fire and scintillation.

Clarity runs eleven grades, Flawless to Included. Color runs twenty-three grades, D (colorless) to Z (visibly tinted). Carat prices in brackets, not a straight line — a stone a hundredth under the next line prices at the lower bracket's rate.
